nodes.label: Video Studio Architecture Doc
nodes.rationale: Target: one local Flask app on localhost:5180 orchestrating existing engines via subprocess; chosen because the autoVSL/dashboard architecture is already proven, so add only a persistent job store, central config, and engine wrappers instead of reimplementing engines.

nodes.label: Video Studio Flask Server (app/server.py)
nodes.rationale: Single Flask app on 127.0.0.1:5180, copied from autoVSL/dashboard/server.py and re-pathed through config.json; serves all tab pages and /api endpoints; one daemon thread per job so long subprocess work never blocks requests.

nodes.label: Persistent Resumable Job Manager
nodes.rationale: Replaces the in-memory jobs dict of both legacy apps: jobs/jobs.json index + per-job log, write-through on every transition so jobs survive restarts; dead running jobs become 'interrupted' with a Resume that re-invokes engines which pick up their own checkpoint caches (ProPainter chunk cache, whisper words.json) — safest resumability win, no engine changes.

nodes.label: GPU Lock / Arbitration
nodes.rationale: Single 4 GB GPU: every GPU engine goes through GPU_LOCK; runner also polls for a foreign erase from legacy apps and waits (ported from subtitle-studio) — never two GPU jobs at once or the card OOMs; _awake_keeper keeps Windows awake mid-job.

nodes.label: fal.ai Cost Gating & Spend Ledger
nodes.rationale: Money is always gated: no paid fal.ai action runs without confirm_cost; every spend is estimated up front (per-clip model price table $0.05-$0.40) and appended to output/fal_spend.json; the UI surfaces live $ estimates and a running spend badge.

nodes.label: Separate Venvs via Subprocess
nodes.rationale: Dependency pins are load-bearing (torch==2.5.1, numpy<2, opencv==4.10.0.84, coqui-tts==0.25.1) so the four venvs are kept separate and called via subprocess; merging environments is explicitly deferred as too risky.

nodes.label: Subtitle Recovery Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Fully local, resumable flow: UI box/auto -> erase_subs.py (ProPainter, chunked with resume cache) -> backup original -> recaption.py (faster-whisper words.json -> lines.json -> ASS captions burned exactly over the erased band); subtitle-studio's engines preferred over the dashboard's copies for better detection and resume.

nodes.label: Dubbing & Lip-Sync Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Edit script -> local_dub.py (XTTS voice clone + synth, fit to length, normalize, mux) -> lipsync.py (Wav2Lip + GFPGAN/CodeFormer under GPU_LOCK) -> per-dub provenance record -> versioned takes; cloud path via fal.ai stays behind the cost gate.

nodes.label: Ads Factory / VSL Build Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Product/research/banks -> build-vsl (Claude CLI, free) -> generate-vo (edge-tts, free) -> generate-video (fal.ai paid OR ComfyUI local free) -> assemble (ffmpeg); autoVSL scripts reused verbatim via subprocess.

nodes.label: Trash / Soft-Delete Restore System
nodes.rationale: Everything reversible: deletes move to .trash/ with index.json (multi-piece bundle delete of video + transcript + dub workdir), restorable via POST /api/trash/restore; originals never destroyed.
